note: Every browser-suite run, and every run of a browser test file alone, on the 2.9.0 release build digest on the Windows x64 measurement computer, in order, with local fixtures only; final-browser.log is the run used by release-summary. The sanity runs ran while an unrelated CPU-bound job outside the suite runner saturated the computer; the failing tests were rerun alone, and the final suites ran on a quiet machine. "nonbrowser" lists the nonbrowser suite runs the same way. "linux" lists the browser jobs of the Linux CI runs on this build digest (GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runners; pass/fail only; linux-ci.json).

runs.run: full browser suite, sanity run before the measurements, under the CPU load of an unrelated job outside the suite runner (16 CPU-bound processes; CPU at or above 95 % for most of the run, free memory down to about 5 GiB; machine/samples in machine-state.json); both failures: Chrome did not confirm its exit within the 3 s cleanup bound (browser-process-exit gap)
failing: a real-browser loopback scan without other gaps ends complete; Chrome service connections stay denied, listed and informational
scripts parsed after the page inspection has ended are not captured, so no capture is left pending when the scan ends

runs.run: chrome-background-browser.test.js alone, focused rerun after the sanity run

completeness-browser.test.js alone, first focused rerun, again under the CPU load of an unrelated job outside the suite runner (16 CPU-bound processes; CPU at or above 95 % for most of the run, free memory down to about 5 GiB; machine/samples in machine-state.json); the same browser-process-exit gap
failing: scripts parsed after the page inspection has ended are not captured, so no capture is left pending when the scan ends
requests a page starts after its inspection has ended are aborted and never sent, so no analysis is left pending when the scan ends

runs.run: completeness-browser.test.js alone, second focused rerun after a quiet-machine gate
completeness-browser.test.js alone, third focused rerun after a quiet-machine gate
full browser suite, final run after the measurements on a quiet machine

nonbrowser.run: full nonbrowser suite, sanity run before the measurements, under the CPU load of an unrelated job outside the suite runner (16 CPU-bound processes; CPU at or above 95 % for most of the run, free memory down to about 5 GiB; machine/samples in machine-state.json); the failure: an analysis turn hit its analysis-turn limit (AnalysisDeferred analysis-turn-limit)
failing: mass mode: an analysis turn that waits longer than its turn, website and scan limits for an engine lane other targets hold still completes and finds the key

nonbrowser.run: mass-scale.test.js alone, focused rerun after the sanity run
full nonbrowser suite, final run after the measurements on a quiet machine

linux.role: measurement run on the version-freeze commit (same build digest)
